description: ✨ Live in the heart of Paris, in one of the capital's liveliest and most iconic neighbourhoods. Enjoy cobbled streets, traditional cafés, trendy boutiques and museums just a stone's throw away. An ideal central location for exploring Paris on foot or easily reaching the must-see sights by metro.The space✨ Discover a stunning 110 m² apartment ideally located on the ground floor in the sought-after Montorgueil–Sentier district, one of the most vibrant and authentic areas of Paris. Perfect for groups, families, or business travellers, this spacious home can accommodate up to 10 guests and beautifully blends vintage charm with modern comfort. The apartment is perfectly located—less than a 5-minute walk from the Palais Royal and around 10 minutes from the Louvre Museum!It features:- An elegant and comfortable living room with a sofa bed for two, a television, and a dining table- A fully equipped and functional open kitchen with a coffee machine, toaster, kettle, microwave, washing machine, stovetop, oven, refrigerator, and more- Four cosy bedrooms, each furnished with a queen-size (160) bed and double bed (140)- Three bathrooms:• A first bathroom with shower + WC• A bathroom with bathtub• A third bathroom with shower connected to one of the bedrooms- An additional separate WC- Plenty of storage space, ideal for longer stays- High-speed WiFi and multiple TVs- Bed linen and towels provided for optimal comfortGuest accessYou'll have access to the whole flat, so you can make the most of your stay and feel right at home.Other things to noteA bank imprint will be requested before you arrive at the accommodation, except for bookings made via Airbnb.
